summary: Competition check 2026-10-09 for AS08: 26 market actors recorded (4 competitors, 13 alternatives); details list what each does, its traction signal, licence and the gap versus the candidate. Source files: R1-orchestration.md, R2-routing.md under docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/research/.
details:
- Paperclip [partner]: Self-hosted control plane for agent companies: org charts, issues, budgets, approvals, routines, CLI adapters with subscription sign-in; alpha plugin SDK Gap/note: Quota fallback requested in #2014/#2743/#3317/#11597, all open; PR #9367 open could close gap Traction: 99.1k GitHub stars, 16.7k forks (https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Model Capacity plugin (TogetherWeOwn) [competitor]: Paperclip plugin choosing model and effort per run from Artificial Analysis data and live CLIProxy quota; shadow-only by default; enforcement via fork hook run.model.resolve Gap/note: Quota pacing and rate-limit reroutes Traction: 0 GitHub stars (https://github.com/TogetherWeOwn/paperclip-plugin-model-capacity). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Tutti [benchmark]: CLI orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenClaw in tmux/worktrees with tutti.toml workflows, cron, checkpoints and handoff packets Gap/note: Checkpoints/handoff exist; provider failover planned Traction: 131 GitHub stars (https://github.com/nutthouse/tutti). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Hydra [benchmark]: Multi-agent orchestrator routing across Claude, Gemini, Codex CLIs with affinity routing claimed to learn from outcomes Gap/note: 429 backoff, concierge provider chain Traction: 3 GitHub stars (krowxx fork also 3) (https://github.com/mikecubed/Hydra). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Conductor [benchmark]: Mac app running parallel Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agents in isolated workspaces; BYO subscriptions; paid cloud workspaces Gap/note: Sanctioned ChatGPT plan use via Sign in with ChatGPT Traction: OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT plan-usage partner; Pro $50/mo (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sign-in-with-chatgpt). Licence: Proprietary (no public repo found). Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenCode [partner]: Open-source coding agent; supports ChatGPT Plus/Pro login; removed Claude Pro/Max plugins citing Anthropic prohibition Gap/note: Sanctioned ChatGPT-plan fallback target Traction: 212.3k GitHub stars (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenClaw [competitor]: Personal assistant gateway with cron jobs and two-stage failover (auth-profile rotation, model fallbacks) incl. Codex OAuth profiles Gap/note: Ordered failover incl. subscription profiles, assistant domain Traction: 391.5k GitHub stars (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Ruflo (claude-flow) [alternative]: Meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex with swarms, memory, loop workers; claims intelligent routing and provider failover (vendor claims) Gap/note: Claims 5-provider failover, unverified Traction: 74.2k GitHub stars (https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Gas Town [benchmark]: Multi-agent workspace manager with Mayor coordinator, workers, git-backed Beads ledger and handoffs across many runtimes Gap/note: Runtime-independent durable work ledger Traction: 18.3k GitHub stars (https://github.com/steveyegge/gastown). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- CLIProxyAPI [alternative]: Proxy exposing CLI OAuth logins as OpenAI/Claude-compatible APIs with multi-account round-robin Gap/note: Account pooling; conflicts with Anthropic credential rules Traction: 54.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- claude-code-router [alternative]: Local control plane routing agent requests across models with rule conditions, retries and ordered fallbacks Gap/note: Request-level ordered fallbacks Traction: 37.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Flock (PR #3) [benchmark]: User-confirmed Claude-to-Codex handoff on spend limit, carrying task and git state Gap/note: Pattern hand-built in Oct 2026 Traction: PR merged 2026-10-06 (https://github.com/yanina-libenson/flock/pull/3). Licence: unknown. Checked 2026-10-09.
- LangGraph / LangSmith Deployment [benchmark]: Stateful agent framework with durable execution; hosted deployment offers cron jobs Gap/note: Durable execution model Traction: 42.9k GitHub stars (https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- LiteLLM [alternative]: OSS gateway with fallbacks/cooldowns/budgets; Auto Router v2 with complexity tiers, effort ladders, Thompson-sampled adaptive pools, Claude Code/Codex harness-aware routing Gap/note: Budget/cooldown fallbacks; Max OAuth passthrough tutorial with ToS risk Traction: 60.5k GitHub stars (https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm). Licence: Open core + LiteLLM Commercial License for enterprise. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenRouter Auto Router [alternative]: Task-type classifier + trailing-7-day spend-share ranking within cost tier; no router fee Gap/note: API credits, not CLI subscriptions Traction: Stripe agreed to acquire (2026-08-19); 10M users per investor (https://menlovc.com/perspective/stripe-to-acquire-openrouter-why-everyone-is-obsessed-with-model-routing/). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Portkey (Prisma AIRS AI Gateway) [alternative]: Gateway with conditional routing, fallbacks, load balancing; acquired by Palo Alto Networks Gap/note: API-key fallbacks only Traction: Acquired for $117M (closed 2026-05-29) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001327567/000132756726000023/panw-20260731.htm). Licence: MIT gateway. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Vercel AI Gateway [alternative]: Managed gateway with model fallbacks and provider ordering Gap/note: API keys only Traction: 200K+ teams (third-party citing Vercel) (https://rywalker.com/research/vercel-ai-gateway). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Cloudflare AI Gateway [alternative]: Routing flows with rate/budget nodes and fallbacks; spend limits Gap/note: User-defined API quotas, not subscription windows Traction: n/a (https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-06-05-spend-limits/). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Kong AI Gateway [alternative]: Enterprise AI Proxy Advanced: multi-model load balancing, semantic routing Gap/note: Enterprise API gateway Traction: n/a (https://developer.konghq.com/plugins/ai-proxy-advanced). Licence: Enterprise tier. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Requesty [alternative]: Hosted gateway with task-label classifier and policy-based routing/fallbacks (vendor) Gap/note: API fallbacks Traction: n/a (https://www.requesty.ai/blog/smarter-than-human-model-picking-introducing-requesty-smart-routing). Licence: Proprietary hosted. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Claude Code built-in model controls [alternative]: fallbackModel on overload (not rate limits), opusplan, per-model effort levels, adaptive reasoning Gap/note: Fallback excludes rate-limit/billing errors Traction: n/a (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OmniRoute [competitor]: Local gateway with quota-aware Subscription->API->Cheap->Free fallback, circuit breakers, limit display for coding CLIs Gap/note: Strongest overlap; credential proxying ToS risk; no task checkpoints Traction: 74.5k GitHub stars (https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- CLIProxyAPI (+ Quotio, 9Router) [competitor]: Exposes Claude Code/Codex/Gemini OAuth subscriptions as APIs with multi-account balancing; ecosystem apps add quota failover Gap/note: Subscription pooling via token proxying; ToS exposure Traction: 54.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- ccusage [partner]: Local usage/cost reports for agent CLIs incl. 5-hour block monitoring Gap/note: Quota signal source Traction: 18.9k GitHub stars (https://github.com/ryoppippi/ccusage). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Account switchers (claude-account-switcher, CCS, amux) [alternative]: Same-provider account auto-switch, multi-provider profiles, manual cross-CLI reassignment Gap/note: No automatic cross-vendor handoff with checkpoint Traction: CCS 2.9k stars; switcher 67 stars; amux 307 stars (https://amux.io/guides/claude-code-rate-limits/). Licence: MIT / OSS. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenCode (+ model-fallback plugins) [alternative]: Multi-provider coding agent without native cross-model fallback; community plugins add chains Gap/note: Gap evidence; plugin-level fallback Traction: Open feature requests (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/7602). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
